LETTER OF GUARANTEE

January 2, 2026

Dear Customer,

Savencia USA LLC guarantees that no articles of food manufactured by our subsidiaries or
distributed by us, shall, upon delivery by us to you, be adulated or misbranded within the meaning of the
Federal Food, Drug and Cosmetic Act of June 25, 1938, as amended (the Federal Act”) or within the
meaning of any state food and drug law, adulteration and misbranding provisions of which are identical
with, or substantially the same as those found in the Federal Act, and that such goods will not be produced
or shipped in violation of Section 404 or 301(d) of said Federal Act. Notwithstanding the foregoing, (a) we
do not guarantee against such goods becoming adulterated or misbranded within the meaning of the
Federal Act or other acts by reason of causes beyond our control, and (b) where goods are shipped under
packaging (including labels) provided by a third party (including you), our responsibility for misbranding
shall be limited to that resulting from the failure of the product to conform to the label furnished by the
third party. | Savencia Cheese USA LLC further guarantees its compliance with the Food Safety
Modernization Act.

In the event an action is brought to enforce any provision of this Letter of Guarantee, you shall be
responsible for our attorney’s fee, to the extent such action is unsuccessful.

If you have any question, or need additional clarification, please contact your sale or export
representative. This Letter of Guarantee shall be valid for no more than one year from the date hereof
and maybe cancelled as to unshipped product upon thirty (30) days written notice.

Sincerely,

Louise Newswanger
Corporate Quality Assurance Manager
Savencia Cheese USA LLC

BOVINE SPONGIFORM ENCEPHALOPATHY STATEMENT

January 2, 2026

Dear Valued Customer:

Savencia Cheese, Fleur de Lait East (New Holland Facility); Fleur de Lait West (City of
Industry Facility), Kolb Lena (Lena Facility) and Rogue Creamery (Medford Facility) is committed
to ensuring that our products adhere to the highest standards of food safety and quality. We
only use food ingredients that have been recognized as safe by leading regulatory authorities.

Our dairy products are sourced from domestic suppliers and manufacturers, we do not
import any raw dairy ingredients.

To the best of our knowledge, the product(s) manufactured at these facilities do not
contain any ingredients that would be subject to BSE (Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy
Statement) or FMD (Foot and Mouth Disease). Neither disease is considered a threat with milk
products, but rather it becomes a concern with the meat of the animal. It affects the brain
tissue and can be found in the marrow, but to the best of our knowledge does not carry
through to the milk.

Sincerely,

Louise Newswanger
Corporate Quality Assurance Manager
Savencia Cheese USA LLC

BIOENGINEERED STATEMENT

January 2, 2026

Dear Valued Customer:

Savencia Cheese USA is committed to ensuring that our products adhere to the highest standards of
food safety and quality. We only use food ingredients that have been recognized as safe by leading
regulatory authorities.

The National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Law, passed by Congress in July of 2016, directed USDA
to establish a national mandatory standard for disclosing foods that are or may be
bioengineered. The Standard defines bioengineered foods as those that contain detectable genetic
material that has been modified through certain lab techniques and cannot be created through
conventional breeding or found in nature. The mandatory compliance date is January 1, 2022. The
Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) developed a List of Bioengineered Foods which can be
accessed by this link https://www.ams.usda.gov/rules-regulations/be/bioengineered-foods-list.

Products manufactured at Savencia Cheese USA (City of Industry, CA, New Holland, PA, Kolb Lena
Inc., Ill and the Imported Cheeses) do not appear on the Bioengineered Food List. Also, these
products do not contain ingredients that are on or derived from those on the AMS list of
Bioengineered Foods List.

Should you have questions or concerns, don't hesitate to get in touch with me at 717.337.3361.

Sincerely,

Louise Newswanger
Corporate Quality Assurance Manager
Savencia Cheese USA LLC
Mobile: (717) 327-3361

Regulatory Inspection Program: FDLW, a division of Savencia Cheese USA is inspected through
various regulatory agencies including the FDA, CDFA, and military.

database. | The Maintenance department sets schedules, which are then automatically

assignments distributed by the Supervisor for completion. Tasks are tracked for completion and

downtime, and errors due to equipment. Preventative and corrective maintenance activities are
carried out on all equipment in the production facility.

on a master register. Items inventory is done once a year to identify non-conformances. Brittle
plastic near the production lines is inspected more frequently to prevent contamination.
